name: OpenClaw Agent State → MQTT
description: Publishes OpenClaw agent state to MQTT, with Home Assistant MQTT Discovery built in.

host.label: MQTT host
host.help: Hostname, IP, or an mqtt:// / mqtts:// URL. Empty keeps the bridge idle.

tls.label: TLS
tls.help: Use MQTT over TLS; the default port becomes 8883.

rejectUnauthorized.label: Verify certificate
rejectUnauthorized.help: Keep on for public brokers; turn off only for a trusted self-signed LAN broker.

instance.label: Instance name
instance.help: Set this when running more than one Gateway, or when the hostname should not appear in MQTT topics.

publishIntervalMs.label: Heartbeat (ms)
publishIntervalMs.help: Also raises expire_after so entities do not flap unavailable.

publishLastTool.label: Publish last tool
publishLastTool.help: Turn off to keep tool names off the broker.

publishSessionDetails.label: Publish session details
publishSessionDetails.help: Hashed session ids and redacted tool names as state attributes.

openclawBin.label: openclaw CLI path
openclawBin.help: Only needed when auto-detection fails for the approval probe.

host.description: MQTT broker host or URL (mqtt:// / mqtts://). Empty keeps the bridge idle.

rejectUnauthorized.description: Verify the broker certificate when tls is on

password.description: MQTT broker password (prefer a SecretRef; never commit it)

instance.description: Display/instance name; set it when running more than one Gateway or when the hostname should not appear in MQTT topics

publishIntervalMs.description: Heartbeat interval; also raises expire_after automatically

openclawBin.description: Path to the openclaw CLI used for the approval probe; empty = auto-detect

publishSessionDetails.description: Publish hashed session ids and redacted tool names as state attributes

publishLastTool.description: Publish the most recent tool name. Turn off to keep tool usage off the broker

maxTurnAgeMs.description: A 'working' session with no activity for this long is treated as crashed

idleSessionTtlMs.description: Idle session records older than this are dropped from memory

expireAfterSec.description: HA marks entities unavailable if nothing arrives for this long
